### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **3** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/dataset.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, `packages/spec/src/data/percent-scale.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`  _(via AnalyticsResult (symbol, a top-level interface))_
- `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`  _(via AnalyticsResult (symbol, a top-level interface), AnalyticsResultResponseSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via AnalyticsResult (symbol, a top-level interface))_
- `content/docs/releases/v9.mdx`  _(via AnalyticsResult (symbol, a top-level interface))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/dataset.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, `packages/spec/src/data/percent-scale.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **207** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **153** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **153**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **98** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 585c9af587a165c066c7815185a6652c2b9c545e` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `0358f62a9aabc9c4edbd4fdedc0c0288195e0cd4` — the merge of head `6ff1a15cf4998a432bada27954b4b9bf359ca3c4` into base `585c9af587a165c066c7815185a6652c2b9c545e`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 0358f62a9aabc9c4edbd4fdedc0c0288195e0cd4 && git checkout 0358f62a9aabc9c4edbd4fdedc0c0288195e0cd4
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 585c9af587a165c066c7815185a6652c2b9c545e 6ff1a15cf4998a432bada27954b4b9bf359ca3c4 && git checkout -B drift-repro 585c9af587a165c066c7815185a6652c2b9c545e && git merge --no-ff 6ff1a15cf4998a432bada27954b4b9bf359ca3c4

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 585c9af587a165c066c7815185a6652c2b9c545e
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 585c9af587a165c066c7815185a6652c2b9c545e` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6ff1a15cf4998a432bada27954b4b9bf359ca3c4`

### ① Derived judgments

Inputs read: card #20126 body and comments `5853407641` / `5853734589` / `5855121790` / `5855122068`; `docs/adr/0053-date-and-datetime-semantics.md` and `docs/adr/0104-field-runtime-value-shape-contract.md` at `origin/main`; the PR body, `diff.patch`, `pr.json`, and the head's check-runs; the repo at `origin/main` (`3875ae67`) and at the head; objectui at `/home/user/objectui` (pin `f8a9d0fb`, `origin/main` `25c7d584`). The supplied `diff.patch` is byte-equal (modulo `index` lines) to `git diff origin/main...6ff1a15c`: 13 files, +71/−34, merge base `e7f69dbb`.

- **The readers, quoted at the head (all three files byte-identical on `origin/main`).** The relay reads `defaultCurrency` ONLY under `fixed`: `packages/services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts:1101-1104` — `const fixedCurrency = f.currencyConfig?.currencyMode === 'fixed' ? f.currencyConfig.defaultCurrency : undefined; return { type: f.type, max: f.max, defaultCurrency: fixedCurrency };`. The resolver, `analytics-service.ts:1809-1812` — `const monetary = !!mc.currency || meta?.type === 'currency'; if (monetary) { const resolved = mc.currency ?? meta?.defaultCurrency ?? context?.currency; if (resolved) fc.currency = resolved; }`. No other production `sourceFieldMeta` provider exists (`git grep` at head: only the plugin's). The spec's own reader, `field.zod.ts:464-465` — `if (config.precision === undefined || config.currencyMode !== 'fixed') return; const contradiction = currencyPrecisionContradiction(config.defaultCurrency, config.precision);`. RIGHT: every in-repo reader is mode-conditioned.
- **「the tenant default currency (the `localization.currency` setting)」 is accurate.** `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:1570/:1584/:1610` read settings namespace `localization`, key `currency`, `scope: 'tenant'`; `assemble-execution-context.ts:368` sets `currency: anonymous ? undefined : localization?.currency`; the resolver consumes it as `context?.currency` (`:1811`). RIGHT.
- **objectui `resolveFieldCurrency`, at the pin AND at main.** At the Console pin `.objectui-sha` = `f8a9d0fb` (same at head and `origin/main`), `packages/i18n/src/currency.ts:32` reads `field?.currencyConfig?.defaultCurrency ||` UNCONDITIONALLY: the fix `ea9d17fb6` (objectui#10461) is NOT an ancestor of the pin. At objectui `main` `25c7d584`, `currency.ts:60` reads `(config?.currencyMode === 'fixed' ? config.defaultCurrency : undefined) ||`. So the new `defaultCurrency` describe's 「Not read under `dynamic`」 holds against every reader in this repository and against objectui `main`, and does NOT hold against the field faces of the Console vendored here. This is the same state the seat recorded as non-blocking for the release lane at the #20179 ACCEPT (`5853407641`), and the identical claim is already published on `main` in the `currencyMode` describe (`field.zod.ts:446`, 「`defaultCurrency` is not read」). Not new to this PR; see ③.
- **Site 9, `field.zod.ts:447` `defaultCurrency` describe (→ `field.mdx:32` / `:240`).** One line; `.length(3)` and `.default('CNY')` untouched. Text is TRUE per the readers above and CONSISTENT with the `currencyMode` describe at `:446` (both: `fixed` = the field's one currency; `dynamic` = tenant default, `defaultCurrency` not read). The two regenerated `field.mdx` rows are byte-equal to the describe; the old string 「Default or fixed currency code」 survives nowhere at head but the changeset's FROM line, and the new string appears only in `field.zod.ts`, `field.mdx` and the changeset (no other generated artifact carries describe text). `Build Docs` check-run success. RIGHT.
- **Site 7 extra, `analytics.zod.ts:111-116` `fields[].currency` describe.** Node evaluation of the new concatenation equals the changeset's TO byte-for-byte, and of the old equals FROM. The stated order (measure `currency` → the field's fixed `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency`, read only under `fixed` → tenant default) is the `:1811` chain plus the `:1101` relay. Ships via the `./api` export. RIGHT.
- **Site 5, `contracts/analytics-service.ts:79-90` TSDoc.** The chain matches `:1809-1812`; 「absent … when no step answers」 is `if (resolved) fc.currency = resolved;`; 「renders as a plain number」 is objectui's `formatMeasure` (`packages/core/src/utils/dataset-format.ts:352`, no-currency fall-through to plain numeral formatting) and `formatAmount`; 「`CurrencyConfigSchema` in `spec/data`」 — `packages/spec/src/data/index.ts:132` re-exports `field.zod`, and `./data` is in the exports map; 「bare number (ADR-0104)」 — ADR-0104 `:60` / `:144`. The `:300` `ADR-0053 Phase 2` citation in the same file is date bucketing and is untouched. RIGHT.
- **Site 6 `percent-scale.ts:14-18` and site 7 `analytics.zod.ts:80` docblock.** Comment-only; the spelled-out chain and its cross-reference (`AnalyticsResult.fields[].currency`) are consistent with the above. ADR-0053 (`docs/adr/0053-date-and-datetime-semantics.md`) contains no occurrence of `currenc`, so dropping the label is correct. RIGHT.
- **Site 8, `liveness/dataset.json` `currency`.** Both `#symbol` anchors resolve at head (`analytics-service.ts:841 export class AnalyticsService`, `plugin.ts:261 export class AnalyticsServicePlugin`); `Spec property liveness` check-run success. The monetary rule and the chain are quoted correctly; 「Re-closed by hand against 1c8b320a8」 — that commit is an ancestor of the head and already carries the `fixedCurrency` ternary (`:1101`). Verdict `live` unchanged. Nit, not a falsehood: the chain sits in the private `enrichResultColumns` (`:1735`), which `queryDataset` calls at `:1434` and `:1691`; 「(`queryDataset`: the currency chain …)」 is pre-existing wording and loosely right. RIGHT.
- **Site 8, `liveness/field.json` `currencyConfig`.** Re-measured at objectui `25c7d584` (= objectui `origin/main`): `currency.ts:60` (conditioned read), `CurrencyField.tsx:55` (`resolveFieldCurrency` call) and `:91` (`formatAmount`, → `formatDisplayNumber` → `Intl.NumberFormat`, `packages/i18n/src/utils/formatting.ts:122`) all exist as cited; 「since objectui#10461」 is `ea9d17fb6`; the old pin `11c1e71e` really read unconditionally at `:32`, which is why re-wording without re-measuring would have been false. The README's house style is satisfied: re-attestation is 「re-reading at its current head, re-pin the commit, stamp the date」 (`liveness/README.md:311-313`), the sha is pinned in the prose, `evidenceScope: cross-repo` kept; no ledger row cites the `.objectui-sha` pin (rows cite `11c1e71e`, `87af769e`, `08ca73f8`, `53ded82bf7`, `9ce096fb0`), so citing `main` is convention-consistent. Verdict `live` unchanged. RIGHT.
- **`verifiedAt` re-dates (2026-08-28 → 2026-09-27; 2026-08-10 → 2026-09-27).** Justified: the evidence was materially re-measured (new anchor, moved line pointers verified above), which is the README's re-verification event, not a re-stamp. `state-counts.md` is untouched.
- **Site 10, `chart-gallery.dataset.ts:44-51`.** `project.object.ts:63-64` — `budget: Field.currency({ label: 'Budget', min: 0 })`, `spent: Field.currency({ …, defaultValue: 0 })`: no `currencyConfig`; the factory (`field.zod.ts:2551`, `({ type: 'currency', ...config })`) injects none. The chain and the prescribed fixed form are correct; the old wrapped `default-`/`Currency` token (the one a line grep missed) is gone. RIGHT.
- **The four comment-only extras.** `account.object.ts:63` — the field declares `currencyMode: 'fixed', defaultCurrency: 'USD'` (`:71`); `semantic-zoo.object.ts:53` — `:60` fixed/USD; `detail-shapes.spec.ts:125` — the asserted `$100,000` is `semantic-zoo.budget`, fixed/USD, and renders the symbol at both objectui shas since a fixed read is unconditional either way; `field.test.ts:176` 「the only mode that reads it」 — two modes, only `fixed` reads; no assertion changed (the `it` at `:202` and its `success:false` pin at `:198` are untouched). No new false statement.
- **Behaviour: text only.** Every hunk is a describe string, TSDoc, comment, JSON `evidence`/`note`/`verifiedAt` string, the changeset or the generated mdx. The only source-level change of form is the re-split string concatenation in `analytics.zod.ts`, evaluated identical above. `field.zod.ts` differs from the merge base by that one line. `Build Core`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Check Changeset`, `Spec property liveness`, `Build Docs` are success at the head; at my last poll 29 success / 5 skipped / 3 in progress (Test Core 1/6, 6/6, Type Check · workspace) / 0 failing.
- **Main drift since the merge base.** `origin/main` moved to `3875ae67`; of the 13 files only `field.zod.ts` changed on `main` (#20209, hunks at `:29-:33` and `:2306-:2330` — the FieldSchema-level precision check removed), not `:447`; GitHub reports `mergeable: true`. The changeset's 「the spec's own precision refinement in `CurrencyConfigSchema`」 stays true after #20209 (the `CurrencyConfigSchema` twin at `:464` is kept).
- **Own census (scopes `packages/spec/src/**`, `packages/spec/liveness/**`, `examples/**`; base `e7f69dbb` → head).** `ADR-0053` within five lines of `currenc`: 6 → 0, the six lines being exactly sites 5–10; wrapped `default-`/`Currency`: 1 → 0; `ADR-0053` lines overall 44 → 38, every remaining one a date use; `defaultCurrency` lines 79 → 86. Sentence by sentence at head: every prose sentence naming `defaultCurrency` in scope carries the `fixed` condition or the not-read-under-`dynamic` negation (`field.zod.ts:446/:447/:460-:462/:1060/:1067`, `analytics.zod.ts:114`, `contracts/analytics-service.ts:82-:84`, `percent-scale.ts:17`, both ledger rows, the four example/test comments); every other line is code or a fixture; the `it` title at `field.test.ts:202` is a label, correctly flagged for (c). A grep for chain sentences that avoid the key token (「source field」/「tenant default」 near `currenc`) finds only `percent-scale.ts:18`, conditioned. Nothing in scope was missed.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/spec': patch` is the right level. `@objectstack/spec` publishes `dist`, `src/**/*.zod.ts` and `liveness` (`package.json` `files`), so the describes, the emitted TSDoc, the two `.zod.ts` sources and both ledger files ship — a changeset is owed and `skip-changeset` would be wrong (AGENTS.md step 3). `Clause-②: no` matches the diff (no key, default, accept set, type or export moves), and only `yes` takes at least `minor`, so `patch` is both floor and ceiling. Precedent: #20179's `.changeset/20126-currency-mode-describe.md`, the same class, `patch`, merged. The FROM → TO pairs are accurate (both evaluated byte-equal to the old and new source strings). No ADR-0087 entry is owed: a disposition marker is required only on a BREAKING changeset (AGENTS.md:1085), nothing authorable is removed or renamed, and `spec-changes.json` is untouched. `Check Changeset` check-run success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Console pin vs. published text (non-blocking, recorded).** At `.objectui-sha` `f8a9d0fb` the Console's field faces still read `defaultCurrency` unconditionally (`currency.ts:32`); the describe, the changeset sentence naming 「objectui's `resolveFieldCurrency`」 and the `field.json` row are true of objectui `main` `25c7d584`. Same state as the #20179 ACCEPT recorded for the release lane, and the `:446` describe already on `main` makes the identical claim. The PR body cites objectui `main` only and does not restate the pin fact; the card carries it (`5853407641`). Not a defect of this PR; it closes when the pin bumps past `ea9d17fb6`.
- **Family append `5855122068`.** The released CHANGELOG entries (`packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:28383` / `:66160`; `service-analytics/CHANGELOG.md:1976` (17.0.0) / `:8504` (17.0.0-rc.2)) are correctly left out: AGENTS.md:699 makes them release-owned, amended only in a dedicated docs-only PR. One more line of the same kind that the append does not list: `packages/services/service-analytics/CHANGELOG.md:10728` (under `## 10.0.0`), 「source-field `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency` → tenant default (`ctx.currency`)」 — same disposition, pointer for the family. The objectui comment pointers (`currency.ts:22`/`:30`, `CurrencyField.tsx:52` at `25c7d584`) are objectui-lane and correctly not filed here.
- **`Part of` with #20196 open.** REST read this act: #20196 is `open`, `pm:queue`, `domain:skills`. So `Part of #20126`, no closing keyword (check-run `Part-of PR must not also close its card` success), and the enumerating pin deferred to remainder (c) per triage `5853734589` is the right shape — (c) covers `skills/**` and can only go green after (a).
- **For (c)'s pin design, two further pointers from the whole-repo census (minus CHANGELOGs) at head:** the remaining `ADR-0053`-near-`currenc` lines are `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md:308` (= #20196), this PR's own `.changeset` negation sentences (a count-based rule over `.changeset/**` would red on them), `current-user-endpoints.ts:908` (a 「used to … citing ADR-0053」 negation), `localization.manifest.ts:6` (ADR-0053 Phase 2 as the lineage of the localization settings family, which includes `currency` — lineage, not the chain), and two plugin-email date uses. The scope triage set for (c) excludes all of these except the skills site.
- **Concurrency.** All 12 open PRs' file lists were scanned: none touches any of the 13 files. Check-runs `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path` / `…the same issue` success.
- PR is a draft; `mergeable_state: blocked` reflected required checks still in progress at read time, not a conflict.
